summary: HCA Healthcare's wholly owned subsidiary HCA Inc. completed a $6.5B multi-tranche senior unsecured notes offering, guaranteed by the parent, under its April 2026 Form S-3 shelf. Tranches include $500M 5.200% 2028s, $300M floating-rate 2028s, $1.0B 5.350% 2029s, $1.25B 5.500% 2031s, $1.2B 5.750% 2033s, $1.5B 6.000% 2036s and $750M 6.500% 2056s, issued via supplemental indentures to the 2011 base indenture. This is a routine investment-grade debt capital raise, not a special situation; watch proceeds use and leverage.
